items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: Yeah, not too much because he played the same instrument. I mean in those, like in smaller bands they were very seldom usable, one clarinet or sax.

ctx.x: Did you ever work with Charlie Cordillo?
Yeah, not too much because he played the same instrument. I mean in those, like in smaller bands they were very seldom usable, one clarinet or sax. But Charlie played excellent clarinet.
Well that's a man that's played with good bands and has never gotten much recognition. That's funny you know.
